shard: Italy and France: every pending row of scripts/data/rosterConfirmation2026.json whose club plays in the Club Manager Serie A or Ligue 1 (51 rows at origin/main 5f2622fd: Italy 32 across Atalanta, Cagliari, Como, Fiorentina, Frosinone, Inter Milan, Lazio, Lecce, Monza, Napoli, Parma, Roma, Sassuolo, Torino, Udinese and Venezia; France 19 across Angers, Brest, Le Havre, Lens, Lille, Lorient, Lyon, Marseille, Monaco, PSG, Strasbourg, Toulouse and Troyes)
method: Each row was read on the web on 2026-10-03 with WebFetch and WebSearch. A row leaves pending only when an official page (family A: the Lega Serie A squad page at legaseriea.it, the Ligue 1 club page at ligue1.com, or a club's own squad page or announcement) and an independent publisher on another host (family B: ESPN squad or player pages, Soccerway, FotMob) agree where the man is. Wikipedia and other wikis are never a source. Birth dates go in the note where a source gives one, so a namesake cannot be mistaken for him; every one of the 51 names appears exactly once in src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts at origin/main 5f2622fd, so no namesake in the game is involved. A season-long loanee is placed at the club he plays for, with loan and loanFrom as information only, the ledger's loanPolicy. The to field is the Club Manager club name the bake knows (checked against the 368 clubs of src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts at origin/main 5f2622fd); realClub is the club as the sources write it. This file is folded into rosterConfirmation2026.json by the lead; nothing reads it directly.
forTheFold: 49 of the 51 rows are settled; 2 stay pending with the reason. Read before folding: (1) Of the 20 movedTo rows, 17 carry an official page that names the destination (a league squad page or the club's own squad page or announcement). Three rest on independent publishers for the destination, with the official voice only on the departure, because the destination club's site could not be read: Jordan Zemura (Watford, on loan from Udinese; Watford's pages were too large to read), Pedro Pereira (Genclerbirligi; HTTP 522) and Abakar Sylla (Gaziantep FK; host not found). Accept these knowingly or re-read the club pages before folding. (2) Three removals rest on one publisher for the destination, which no Club Manager league models either way, while the departure is two-sourced: Farid El Melali (CR Belouizdad), Presnel Kimpembe (Al-Kharitiyath) and Shavy Babicka (United FC). Damian Pizarro's destination is Audax Italiano's own announcement as quoted in full by En Cancha. (3) Two notCurrent rows are medium confidence and should be re-checked at the next adjudication: Gaetano Castrovilli (unattached is INFERRED: not in Lazio's or Cesena's 2026/2027 squad, no club on Soccerway, ESPN stale at Cesena) and Alessio Iovine (retired rests on Soccerway alone; off Como is two-sourced). (4) Pending: Riccardo Sottil, where the families disagree (Fiorentina's own page and the league page leave him out, Soccerway and ESPN's player page keep him at Fiorentina, injured, under contract to 2027), so he stays at Fiorentina; and Jordan Amavi, where no official source could be read and both independent publishers show him at no club, so the recommendation is to hold him out once one official voice confirms. (5) Information-only loan fields, per the ledger's loanPolicy: Zemura (Watford from Udinese), Lucas Michal (Cercle Brugge from Monaco), Pizarro (Audax Italiano from Udinese), Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca from Cagliari), Samuele Mulattieri (Hellas Verona from Sassuolo), Antonio Candela (Catanzaro from Spezia) and Babicka (United FC from Crvena zvezda). (6) Every to value is spelled exactly as in src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts, diacritics included (CF Montréal, Kasımpaşa, Gençlerbirliği, Lausanne-Sport, Gaziantep FK). (7) The legaseriea.it squad pages carry no season label; each row's publisher text names a summer 2026 arrival on the same page to show it is current, and the ESPN squad pages are labelled 2026-27. Spellings that differ by publisher: ESPN writes Lucas Michel, Soccerway writes Di Stefano, Kasimpasa's site writes Benedyzcak. ESPN's Lorient squad links Mohamed Bamba to a namesake's page, so ESPN is not used for him. (8) Found while reading, OUTSIDE this shard and not acted on: David Alaba, notCurrent in the ledger since 2026-09-15 as unattached, is in Udinese's current squad on legaseriea.it (shirt 5, defender) and on ESPN's 2026-27 Udinese squad, so he now has a modelled club and the ledger row is stale; Branco van den Boomen (pending at Ajax) is in Angers's squad on angers-sco.fr and on ESPN's 2026-27 Angers page; a Dan Bentley is in Coventry City's 2026 squad in the Premier League data feed (Daniel Bentley is pending at Wolves), not checked to be the same man.
